content.short: Bifrost is the Liquid Staking Standard for Any Chain.
content.description: Bifrost is a Liquid Staking app-chain designed to work across multiple blockchains. It uses decentralized cross-chain interoperability to empower users to earn staking rewards and DeFi yields with greater flexibility, liquidity, and high security across networks. With support for Ethereum, Polygon, Arbitrum, Solana, BNB Chain and other supported chains, Bifrost enables cross-chain staking opportunities while preserving safety and liquidity.
